video_title: Will Boston BOO Jaylen Brown? PG13 STEALS Spotlight From Brown-Tatum Beef!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins and Lou Williams on Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: To me, honestly, the entire night was a bit overblown. It was boring.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: To me, honestly, the entire night was a bit overblown. It was boring. It wasn't that exciting to be honest when it came to the matchup between the two. I also believe Paul George was the star of the night. As far as the interaction before the game, I felt like Jaylen Brown has made it clear that we're not cool. There's nothing to really talk about, we're not cool. To me it was a bit performative. It was almost like, let me be the good guy in the spotlight while I can make him look like the bad guy in the spotlight.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I'm with you on that. I think it was representative of their personalities and how they both have been going about this interaction for the entire time. Jayson Tatum is like, look, whatever happened has happened, but I'm still going to acknowledge you, we did some great things together. Jaylen Brown is like, no, we still got some things we need to air out. Until we get these things aired out, this is where we are. It's not an actual beef, it's not a problem where when we see each other we're going to lock up, but we just aren't rocking right now.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum dynamic
quotes.excerpt: It's been like a breakup and Jaylen Brown's the one that feels scorn and still upset about it.
quotes.quote: It's been like a breakup and Jaylen Brown's the one that feels scorn and still upset about it and being passive-aggressive about it. But they shouldn't be because they're both great players, they're both having All-Star seasons, and they're both on contending teams to win a championship this year. We don't know everything that happened, but clearly Jaylen Brown is still upset and wants to, at a later day, maybe get over this and have a grown-up conversation about it and move on. But right now, I can't be cool with you because clearly he knows something we don't and he's still a bit frustrated.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Paul George's consistent performance this season
quotes.excerpt: As far as Paul George, he went out and he did his job.
quotes.quote: As far as Paul George, he went out and he did his job. He put all the BS aside. It was almost like, man, that's their issue. If y'all want to pay attention to that, y'all do that. I'm going to come out here and I'm going to hoop tonight. And to be honest, he's done that the entire season. He's been very consistent since the beginning of this season. So credit to him, regardless of the negative noise that's been around his name.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Paul George's trade and current form
quotes.excerpt: Paul George clearly took that personal, has been in the lab because he looks unbelievable.
quotes.quote: Paul George clearly took that personal, has been in the lab because he looks unbelievable. He looks prime Paul George. He looks athletic, he looks in shape, he looks healthy. And that's the only issue ever with Paul George is health. When he's on, he's one of the best two-way players ever in this league. He is cold-blooded and he is showing that. Paul George is playing the way he's playing, it's making it look like a pretty solid deal.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on why Paul George is a genuine fit for Boston
quotes.excerpt: Paul George is a better fit at this moment because there's clarity in the roles.
quotes.quote: I think at this point in both of their careers and where the Celtics are and where Jayson Tatum is in Boston, Paul George is a better fit at this moment because there's clarity in the roles, there's clarity in how we're going to move forward. It's hard for me to say he's a better fit than Jaylen Brown when I just seen them two dudes win a championship together. It's hard to say that. They got to the mountaintop and they came down with the trophy. That sounds like a great fit to me. But update your software, this present date with everything that's transpired, Paul George came in and immediately said, hey, this is Jayson Tatum's team, I'm here to support him, I'm at a stage of my career where I'm just here to help, I'm here to be positive, and I'm here to influence winning. That's what he's been able to do.
